numericalProtocol.horizon: 1000 dynamical times, extended to 3000 if unsettled
numericalProtocol.limitCycle: last five radius maxima spread <1e-7, relative period spread <1e-4, successive phase-aligned state waveforms <1e-3 of each state amplitude
numericalProtocol.equilibrium: maximum component distance from (1,0,1,1) <1e-7 throughout final ten dynamical times
numericalProtocol.nearEquilibrium: distance<1e-4 and final ten-time radial amplitude<1e-5; residual decay is not labeled a limit cycle
numericalProtocol.interpolation: cubic Hermite state interpolation from endpoint RHS; luminosity recomputed from state; radial maxima found by bisection on Hermite V
numericalProtocol.runaway: radius>15 or |H|>1e5; integration/domain failures retained separately
numericalProtocol.lightcurvePeak: periodic local maximum prominence exceeds max(1e-6, .001*peak-to-peak L)
